name: Awkward Date Hero
source:
You may be awkward, but so are they. This is your last resort for finding someone
right for you. There are only five girls left, can at least one of them tolerate your nonsense?

This game is a parody of the dating simulator genre and is NOT meant to be taken seriously.
Annoy the other person to gain points but be careful not to go too far, they might walk out on you. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/806350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你可能会感到尴尬，但他们也是如此。这是你寻找某人的最后手段
适合你。女孩子只剩下五个了，至少有一个能容忍你的胡言乱语吗？

该游戏是对约会模拟器类型的模仿，并不意味着要认真对待。
惹恼对方以获得分数，但要小心不要走得太远，他们可能会抛弃你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/806350/]Steam[/url]]
